title: Daily Ledger — Aug 1 → Oct 4 read in full
summary: Read two months of conversations (Aug 1–Oct 4) in full via 12 parallel readers over a lossless conversation extractor, scanned 23 repos with the 41-detector suite, deep-researched current external issues, deduped hard against the complete 2,115-entry live ledger, and appended 690 vetted entries (append-only). The curated catalogue grew from 428→868 bugs/security and 117→367 optimisers, finally giving the newer apps (Abba, Pixelbake, Hopefil, Evertrue, Fullfill, Stepapa, Joy, GitBagel, PatentCake) real coverage. Deployed and verified live.

tasks.desc: Compressed ~1.5GB of transcripts into 30.5MB of pure conversation across 109 sessions (every user msg, reasoning block, tool action; base64 dropped)
12 parallel readers each read their batch IN FULL and extracted vetted bugs/security/optimisers with app + file:line
XSS-INNERHTML HIGH on 18/23, PRIV-NO-DELETE 14/23, PRIV-NO-POLICY 13/23; pinned Joy PII-in-URL, GitBagel quote-unsafe esc(), Stitchhooky a11y
OWASP-LLM 2025, Veracode AI-code (45% fail/86% XSS), WebAIM Million 2025, Cloudflare account-wide 100K/day quota + subrequest limits
Deduped vs the full 2,115-entry live ledger (428 catalogue + 399 harvested + 99 scanner + 756 submitted); appended 690 net-new across all 7 detector families
gen.mjs regenerated every surface; committed in 2 parts (53327d4, c0b2490), pushed, deployed, verified live bugs.json=868

features: Lossless conversation extractor (extract.mjs): keeps every message/reasoning/tool action, drops base64 — makes a month of transcripts actually readable in full
Dedup+append pipeline with dry-run, skip-logging, and dedup against the complete live ledger (/api/admin/recurrence), not just the stale local file
bugfixes: Caught that the local bugs.json (Aug 17) is stale vs the 756-entry live submitted tier; fixed dedup to use the full 2,115-entry live corpus before appending
findings: CRITICAL (open): Pixelbake isAdmin() trusts any handle in ADMIN_HANDLES — rhema/rhemajoy are unclaimed on the live app, so anyone could sign up as one and hit /api/admin/grant (1M credits, any plan)
Pixelbake /api/auth/signin has no rate limit/lockout and leaks handle-exists via different errors
Hallalu CRM private investor deck was reachable via //_pitch.html and %5F path tricks, and deck.js was a public asset (fixed by moving to Worker modules)
PatentCake GET /api/inventions is unauthenticated — exposes all 24 disclosures (novelty risk)
Evertrue stores Etsy OAuth tokens + shared secret as plaintext D1 columns
Joy mail session cookie is an unsalted SHA-256 of the 6-digit PIN (offline-recoverable, 30-day, no logout); SEND binding unrestricted
Bug Ledger harvester copied a live Joy Day sign-in PIN into a public append-only row; 73% of harvested rows are mid-sentence fragments
Fullfill authed() let everyone in when ACCESS_CODE was unset; public submit endpoint had no size cap (denial-of-wallet)
Finished. bundled CC-CEDICT/JMdict/FreeDict dictionary data with no attribution (GPL COPYING file never read) — open verification task
Trademark/name clashes flagged (open): Pixelbake, Abba, Joy Day, GitBagel, Evertrue, Kindly, Fullfill, Payrails

Unsourced marketing claims still live: Instagram 'sends > saves' on a carousel, Analysis '4 Cloudflare video models' (CF lists none), Pixelbake credit figures (42/51/40 vs 42/63 charged), /sell 53.1% figure nobody could source
insights: The ledger has two tiers: static bugs.json (canonical, == deployed, curated) and the D1 'submitted' stream (756 session self-logs). The daily pass's job is to promote vetted findings into the catalogue; dedup must run against BOTH, via /api/admin/recurrence.
Cloudflare's free 100K requests/day is ACCOUNT-wide across all ~34 Workers on this account — one chatty Worker (polling/crons/live boards) can starve the rest.

Disk hit ENOSPC repeatedly under heavy parallel-agent load; it recovered each time. Add a df preflight before big multi-agent runs; never blanket-delete tasks/*.output or ~/.npm (both caused failures).

Several 'done'/'verified' claims across sessions were asserted without reproduction, and real TikTok/IG effect names were deleted on a blocked researcher's 'could not verify' — the verify-the-critic doctrine caught and restored them.
